The official index lists the February 15, April 19, June 7 and November 8, 2022 elections for this year. Archive copies of all four official results pages were opened. None lists a Mayor contest. The November page lists Proposition H, which moved the Mayor election to November of presidential election years and extended the current terms to January 2025. Proposition H passed with 203,855 yes votes against 82,391 no votes. The index page was opened at https://www.sf.gov/past-election-results. The official index lists the June 2, 2026 Consolidated Statewide Direct Primary Election as the only city election in this year before the 2026-09-14 cutoff. The archive copy of its official results page (captured 2026-09-28) lists Governor, Superior Court, state, congressional, Board of Education, Board of Supervisors Districts 2 and 4, Treasurer and ballot measures.
